The AIRY Blueprint · 04
Layer 01 · The Shared Brain
The company's brain is the moat
The belief
Agents never start from zero. They start from everything your company already knows.
From: The AI-Native Blueprint
Practical moves
1
Capture
Pull calls, docs, support tickets, and market signal into one place, automatically.
2
Curate
Structure it as plain Markdown folders agents can read: facts, opinions, approved language.
3
Compound
Every run writes back what worked, so the next run starts smarter.
In practice: people set the goals, agents do the work, and context remembers. That loop, not the chatbot, is what makes a company AI-native.
The AIRY Blueprint · 05
Layer 02 · Designed Workflows
Design the work, not just the prompt
The belief
The output is still the report. The difference is the work is designed.
From: Graph Engineering
Practical moves
1
Qualify
Use a graph only when work has multiple steps, sources, checks, risk, or approvals. Otherwise, write a better prompt.
2
Separate
Run steps in parallel where you can, and make sure the checker is never the writer.
3
Gate
Put the human approval exactly where mistakes get expensive.
In practice: draw the graph before you automate the graph. Run it by hand once, then automate.
The AIRY Blueprint · 06
Layer 03 · Authority Content
You do the thinking. AI does the repeating.
The belief
If an LLM can guess it, you don't own it. Experience is the one thing AI can't copy.
From: The AI Authority Engine
Practical moves
1
Document the unmade data set
Milestones, failures, anecdotes, and the stances where you break from your industry.
2
Split your energy 80 / 20
80% on timeless frameworks you write; 20% on timely posts AI remixes from them.
3
Polish the last 1%
One word change restores your voice. No full rewrites.
In practice: AI compiles your intellectual property. It never invents your story.
The AIRY Blueprint · 07
Layer 04 · Growth Engine
Build the system behind the marketing
The belief
Messages sent is activity. Qualified replies are signal.
From: Marketing Engineering
Practical moves
1
Listen
Turn calls, reviews, churn, and CRM data into customer truth, with receipts.
2
Build & ship
One real pain becomes five assets, and outbound fires on timing, not volume.
3
Learn
Evals grade every output on voice, buyer fit, approval, and pipeline, then feed the memory.
In practice: AI makes output cheap. Judgment makes it valuable.
The AIRY Blueprint · 08
Layer 05 · Verified Visibility
Verified humans beat raw algorithms
The belief
The future belongs to those who systemize verifiable human signals.
From: The Digital Credibility Stack
Practical moves
1
Brands & creators
Claim Search Profiles and feed the Discover follow loop.
2
Local businesses
Build compliant review engines that surface the badged Local Guides already in your customer base.
3
Professionals
Verify skills with digital badges, and write the story that proves the value.
In practice: when AI answers the question, being the trusted, cited source is the new ranking.
